title: Hum Aapke Hain Kaun
desc: Prem and Nisha fall in love through family celebrations, but after tragedy, duty and family expectations challenge their chance at happiness.

title: Apne Paraye
desc: Wealthy Sidheshwari hands over household control to her sister-in-law Sheila, but peace is soon threatened when Harish arrives with his cunning wife Naintara, who plots to manipulate her.

title: Khiladi 786
desc: The underachieving son of a marriage bureau owner attempts to marry a don's daughter to a supposed police officer in an effort to prove his worth to his father.

title: Khichdi 2: Mission Paanthukistan
desc: When an intelligence agent discovers Praful's uncanny resemblance to the king of Paanthukistan, he seeks the Parekh family's help to replace the missing monarch and save the kingdom from crisis.

title: Upkar
desc: Bharat gives up everything to educate his brother Puran. But Puran becomes greedy and joins the drug trade, forgetting Bharat's sacrifices and love.

title: Indian
desc: Policeman Raj arrests terrorist Wasim Khan and earns praise, but when his father-in-law is mysteriously murdered, Raj is framed and must prove his innocence.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Bhoot Returns
desc: Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with their children, Taman and Nimmi. But mysterious events soon threaten their lives, forcing them to escape for survival.

title: Jersey
desc: Arjun, a gifted yet failed cricketer, makes a daring comeback in his late thirties, driven by his dream of playing for India and fulfilling his son's wish for a jersey.

title: Saathi
desc: Suraj and Amar witness their father's murder. Later, Suraj embraces crime while Amar resists, leading to conflict between brothers torn apart by choices, loyalty, and vengeance.

title: Akele Hum Akele Tum
desc: Rohit and Kiran, aspiring singers, fall in love and marry. But responsibilities weigh heavily, straining their bond until Kiran decides to leave, breaking Rohit's heart and dreams.

title: Good Newwz
desc: Two couples with the same last name undergo IVF, eagerly awaiting their babies. Chaos erupts when they discover their sperm samples have been accidentally swapped.

title: Naya Daur
desc: A man starts a bus service to make quick profits, but his actions disrupt the peace and threaten the livelihood of local farmers and workers.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary reunites with a British officer he once shared a bond with. Together, they set aside differences to fight despotic rulers, forging an inspiring path to freedom.

title: Bachchhan Paandey
desc: Myra picks dreaded gangster Bachchhan Paandey as the subject of her film, but her plan spirals when the terrifying hooligan decides he wants to star in the movie himself.

title: Shubh Mangal Saavdhan
desc: Mudit, a shy boy, wins Sugandha's heart and plans marriage. But their relationship faces turmoil when they discover his erectile dysfunction, challenging their love before the wedding.
